response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT * FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0), driver_averages AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY driverId), overall_mean_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins FROM driver_averages) SELECT da.driverId, da.avg_points, da.avg_wins, da.avg_wins - om.mean_wins as difference FROM driver_averages da CROSS JOIN overall_mean_wins om ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Higher side' of the 1.0 dividing line is interpreted as points > 1.0 (strictly greater), not >= 1.0. The dividing line itself (exactly 1.0) is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'higher side' could include the dividing line itself, interpreted as points >= 1.0, which would keep records with exactly 1.0 points as part of the higher group.
